course.title: Principles of Environmental Engineering
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A rectangular settling tank without mechanical equipment is to treat 1.6 million (13) liters per day of raw water. The sedimentation period is to be 4.1 hours. The flow velocity is 70mm/minute and depth of water and sediment is 4000mm. If an allowance of 1500 mm for sludge is made, determine the length and width of the settling tank.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
